findingsCorrected.problem: The original sequence described FreeSpace as printing a saved snapshot without warning that printing mutates stored free-block lengths. Reprinting the same aggregate can display hypothetical coalesced triples as real free blocks.
findingsCorrected.primaryEvidence: jdk-25.0.3+9 codeHeapState.cpp, CodeHeapState::print_freeSpace, lines 1558-1559 assigns lenTriple back to FreeArray[ix].len.
findingsCorrected.executedEvidence: Owned Temurin 25.0.3+9 JVM: 18 free-list blocks; 17 changed on repeat printing; largest block 768 -> 2304 bytes. A new aggregate restored the complete original list, largest 768 bytes. Compiler.codecache output before and after was identical.
findingsCorrected.fix: Require a new aggregate before each FreeSpace, preserve command order/first evidence and relate aggregation time to the question. Distinguish diagnostic snapshot mutation from live allocator changes.
findingsCorrected.preventedDecisionError: Treating repeated diagnostic output as actual reclamation, contiguous headroom or proof that a failing allocation should fit.

findingsCorrected.problem: The reference recommended standalone Compiler.CodeHeap_Analytics MethodNames and described its names as every nmethod. On the target update, the dispatcher refuses standalone MethodNames despite advertising it in help and returning exit 0. Even all produced empty name sections in the owned probe while alive methods existed.
findingsCorrected.primaryEvidence: jdk-25.0.3+9 CompileBroker::print_heapinfo only invokes print_names for all, holds compilation/code-cache locks during all and discards the snapshot afterward. Oracle jcmd documentation scopes Compiler.codelist to alive compiled methods.
findingsCorrected.executedEvidence: Standalone MethodNames returned only the refusal at exit 0. all emitted MethodNames section headers but no HotWork names. Compiler.codelist listed 40 HotWork entries. FreeSpace after all reported no aggregated data.
findingsCorrected.fix: Correct the named-method investigation to use Compiler.codelist for alive nmethods, explain standalone rejection and all's lifecycle/cost, and require actual inventory coverage instead of treating empty sections or headers as absence proof.
findingsCorrected.preventedDecisionError: Concluding generated methods or method-handle activity are absent from a command that never produced a usable inventory.
